components.label: Investments at fair value
components.source: 2026-03-31 Form 10-Q, accession 0001193125-26-222241, Investments at fair value tag

evidence.quote: Form 10-Q accession 0001193125-26-222241 reports Investments at fair value of $6,824,822,000 at March 31, 2026.

rationale: The filing's investments-at-fair-value amount is a complete single-tag grand total, not a schedule subtotal. It exactly equals the sum of all 217 extracted holding fair values. It is 97.33% of total assets and leaves $187,190,000 of non-investment assets, a plausible balance-sheet remainder. The companyfacts tag therefore captured the full investment portfolio.
